title: How Cats Always Land On Their Feet

scenes.say: Cats may survive high falls better than medium ones.
It starts with a built-in skill called the righting reflex.
scenes.heading: THE SECRET

scenes.say: Mid-air, a cat turns its head first, then twists its front half, then its back half.
scenes.heading: MID-AIR

scenes.say: Kittens start doing it at just a few weeks old.
scenes.label: and master it by about 7

scenes.say: In a famous 1987 study of cats that fell from New York buildings, about nine in ten survived.
scenes.label: of fallen cats survived

scenes.say: And above about seven floors, injuries seemed to go down. The theory: the cat relaxes and spreads out, like a tiny parachute.
scenes.heading: ABOVE 7 FLOORS

scenes.say: But careful. Cats that died in falls may never have reached the vet. So scientists still debate it. Keep your windows closed.
scenes.heading: THE CATCH

scenes.say: Has your cat ever survived a crazy fall?
